tools.name: arclight_search_events
tools.description: Search real, upcoming events in a city, optionally narrowed to a topic and timeframe. Every event is aggregated from a live source (Luma, Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, Skiddle, confs.tech and others) and links back to it — Arclight never invents listings and holds no tickets. Read-only. Returns paginated

tools.name: arclight_get_event
tools.description: Fetch the full detail of one event by its Arclight slug (or its arclight.events URL): title, start time in the venue's own timezone, price, tags, description and the source link. Read-only.

tools.name: arclight_city_picks
tools.description: A small curated set of events worth going to in a city over the next few days, chosen for variety rather than raw recency. Use when someone asks what is worth doing rather than for an exhaustive list. Read-only.

tools.name: arclight_list_cities
tools.description: List every metro Arclight covers, with the slug to pass to the other tools, plus the available topic filters. Call this first when unsure whether a city is covered. Read-only, no arguments required.
